SELECT r.id, r.flower_id, r.result_variant_id, r.note, r.sort_order, v.id AS result_id, v.flower_id AS result_flower_id, v.stars AS result_stars, v.color_name AS result_color_name, v.image_url AS result_image_url, v.sort_order AS result_sort_order FROM flower_breeding_rules r LEFT JOIN flower_variants v ON v.id = r.result_variant_id WHERE r.flower_id = #{flowerId} ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT o.id, o.rule_id, o.side, o.variant_id, v.flower_id, v.stars, v.color_name, v.image_url, v.sort_order FROM flower_breeding_rule_options o JOIN flower_variants v ON v.id = o.variant_id WHERE o.rule_id = #{ruleId} AND o.side = 'LEFT' ORDER BY v.sort_order ASC, v.id ASC
